statement: An employee can see remaining annual leave without asking HR.
A leave request and its decision are recorded with requester, approver, time, and comment.
A supervisor can see approved leave in their own department before approving.
The annual balance changes when annual leave or cuti bersama is approved, and is restored on a valid cancellation.
HR publishes holidays and cuti bersama once, and day counts use that calendar.
Sick-leave reason and file are limited to the employee and HR.
HR can export approved leave for a month without retyping it.
12 annual working days after 12 months of service. Balance is 0 before that.
Only annual leave and cuti bersama deduct the annual balance, and only on approval.
Sick leave of more than one working day needs an attachment before submit.
Annual leave starts at least three working days after submission.
notes: Example: submitted 18 Nov 2026, earliest start 23 Nov 2026.

statement: A half day is annual leave, one working day, morning or afternoon, and deducts 0.5.
HR approves after the supervisor when working days exceed 3, or the type is unpaid or special.
Weekends, public holidays, and cuti bersama dates are not counted as requested leave days.
Overlapping Submitted, Returned, Pending HR, or Approved dates are refused.
Finance annual leave cannot overlap a configured blackout.
The employee may cancel an approved request only when the start is at least one working day away.
Sick-leave reason and attachments are visible to the employee and HR only.
Status changes and balance adjustments store actor, Asia/Jakarta timestamp, and comment.
HR creates cuti bersama as approved leave, deducted once.
A session exists only for a company Google account that matches an active employee.
The employee sees entitled, used, and remaining annual days.
An employee can save a draft without notifying an approver.
notes: Covered by the save extension. No separate UAT case. Drafts are asserted absent in TC-17 and TC-18.

statement: Working days exclude weekends and published holidays and cuti bersama.
Submit is refused, and the balance unchanged, when BR-01, BR-03, BR-04, BR-08, BR-09 fail or the count is 0.
A valid submit sets Submitted and emails the supervisor without sick-leave attachments.
The supervisor can approve, reject, or return a direct report's Submitted request. Reject and return need a comment.
BR-06 routes to Pending HR. HR can approve, reject, or return.
Approval deducts annual balance only for annual leave and cuti bersama, and updates the department calendar.
The employee is emailed on approve, reject, and return, including the comment.
The employee can cancel a future approved request and the deduction is restored.
Sick-leave reason and attachments are returned only to the employee and HR Admin.
HR maintains holidays, blackouts, commented adjustments, and a one-time cuti bersama run.
Monthly CSV lists approved leave dates and omits other statuses.
Status changes and adjustments store actor, timestamp, and comment.
Half-day annual leave stores 0.5 and morning or afternoon.
Bahasa Indonesia by default, English available and persisted.
notes: Checked at UAT entry, not a numbered case.

statement: Balance page and supervisor queue usable within 2 seconds on a 10 Mbps office connection with the 95-employee fixture.
notes: Spot check at UAT entry. Not a load test. Severity if unusable is an entry blocker.

statement: Pilot availability target 99.5 percent on weekdays 08:00-18:00 WIB, excluding announced maintenance.
notes: IT uptime check. Not a penalty clause and not a UAT click.

statement: Audit events and attachments retained for five years.
notes: IT confirms in writing before go-live.

statement: Permissions are enforced on the server, not only in the interface.
